title_as_printed: Dew Points of Three Mixtures of Carbon Dioxide-Water
pressure_note: pressure of the sample at the dew point, Heise Bourdon gauge on the water back-up system behind the piston (total pressure)

value.what: overall (filled) mole fraction CO2 of the binary mixture;  Printed only on the first row of each mixture (filled down).

conversion_needs: y_h2o = 1 - (mole fraction carbon dioxide); composition is the filling composition, known to about 1% (text).
Mole fraction is printed on the first row of each mixture only; fill down (rows 1-3 = 0.530, 5-8 = 0.625, 10 = 0.789).
notes: Two pressure uncertainties are printed as '+- 7' (rows 1 and 8: 114.4 +- 7 and 264.5 +- 7), confirmed in the 250 dpi image; other pressure uncertainties are 1.3-5.1 MPa, so these may be misprints for 0.7 or genuine 7 MPa; kept as printed. Synthetic method: transition two phases -> one phase observed visually on isochoric heating (and on cooling), sometimes confirmed by P-T discontinuity. The paper calls all points dew points; three mixtures 53.0, 62.5, 78.9 mol% CO2. 2026-10-11 coordinator: property set to other (phase-boundary point of a mixture of fixed overall composition, synthetic method, near the critical curve); not converted to a gas-phase water content, as for Gehrig 1986 and Blencoe 2001.
